title: Filings: Trump purchased up to $5M each in Broadcom, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia stocks on July 23, the same day he unveiled his AI action plan (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Filings: Trump purchased up to $5M each in Broadcom, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia stocks on July 23, the same day he unveiled his AI action plan — President Trump and his family reaped vast financial rewards from a memecoin that generated losses for hundreds of thousands of investors.
